criteria.text: `package-mac.mjs` bundles a built `apps/api_server` (compiled `dist/`, `node_modules` with native deps rebuilt for the packaged Node/Electron ABI, `.mcp-roles`) into `Contents/Resources/api_server`, following the SAME SHAPE `tools/release/*.sh` + `.github/workflows/desktop_release.yml` already use for the Flutter app's bundled CLI server.
A packaged `dist/Rhythm.app`, run on a machine with NO monorepo checkout, successfully spawns its own api_server via the bundled path (NOT the dev-mode fallback) and reaches `Live`.
criteria.reason: Final gate copied Rhythm.app outside every checkout, used a temporary HOME/userData and isolated ports, then observed the app-owned child argv as Contents/Resources/node/bin/node + Contents/Resources/api_server/dist/server.js, API /health OK, /opencode/health ready, a packaged live-smoke receipt with environment.mode=Live and a real 200 /agent-sessions read, and clean shutdown.
